issue: Quality collection sample exceeds estimation sample
check: The text explains that some counties have fewer than the target pair count, but does not explain the further drop from collected pairs to Table 6. The county group counts add correctly. Unknown filters/missingness prevent identifying the estimation county count.

issue: New and old contributor counts are not an exhaustive arithmetic partition
check: Old is defined as active before seeding, while new means first activity in the county-period. Returning post-seeding entrants need not belong to either. The prose says divide into two groups, but definitions do not establish exhaustion; no correction made.

issue: Ownership measure units versus contributor counts
check: The ownership rows say contributions, while discussions sometimes say old users or contributors. Different units can explain why these are not bounded by the old-user count; exact D51 formulas are not available, so a subset-count identity is unjustified.

issue: Figure 4 pretrend prose versus plotted intervals

values.prose: treatment and control following a parallel trajectory before seeding

check: The early follow-on confidence intervals appear entirely above zero relative to the inferred reference year. This qualifies a claim of no pretreatment differences, but it is not a formal joint parallel-trends test. Contributor preperiod intervals appear to include zero. Visual reading uncertainty retained.

issue: Figure 4 time unit differs within the text
locator: D01, PDF p. 14–15, §3.2.2 and Figure 4 note
check: County-year is the explicit model unit; the conflicting quarter wording is retained as documentation ambiguity, not silently rewritten.

issue: Figure 5 terminal estimate versus Table 4
locator: D01, PDF p. 15–16, Table 4 column 4 and Figure 5
check: The intervals do not overlap. Both are described as the 2014 follow-on cross-section with controls and covariate fixed effects, but unknown sample/aggregation/implementation differences cannot be ruled out. No adjustment to either value is made.

issue: Figure 6 density claims versus plot

values.text: negative for bottom 80 percent; top 20 percent significantly more positive; top decile doubles follow-on and raises contributors about 60%

check: Contributor decile eight is visually positive, and decile-nine follow-on uncertainty crosses zero. Top-decile plotted coefficient and percent wording cannot be compared exactly without the missing model/transform specification; retain both.

issue: Figure 6 commitment significance claim versus bars

values.text: only top one percentile unaffected; rest deterred

check: The 25th and 50th percentile bars appear to touch or cross zero as does the 99th. Confidence level is unstated, and visual precision cannot establish strict inequalities; do not translate the prose into exact p-values.

values.baseline_supplement: ten labels including unemployment rate and Young Pop.
